name: Naturalisation (Residency-Based Registration)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a minimum of 7 years of continuous legal residence, maintained throughout with valid work and residency permits. Meeting the 7-year mark does not guarantee approval -- each application is investigated on its merits.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years of continuous legal residence with valid permits throughout.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 7 years' continuous legal residence with valid work/residency permits
Application for Registration as a Citizen (official form)
Application fee EC$150 + registration fee EC$1,500-$2,200

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: continuous residence with valid work/residency permits throughout the 7-year period

sources.title: St Vincent Times -- Understanding Citizenship, Eligibility for St Vincent Passport: naturalisation requires a minimum 7 years of continuous legal residence with valid work and residency permits throughout; each application investigated individually with no guarantee of approval at the 7-year mark
Prime Minister's Office, Government of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines -- Citizenship: general application fee (EC$150) and registration fee (EC$1,500-$2,200)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines' initial build. STATUS: DRAFT -- the 7-year residence figure and its 'no guarantee even if met' character are sourced only to a tier-3 news outlet, not the primary Citizenship Act (which could not be retrieved in readable form for this build -- see vc_citizenship_by_descent.json's notes). No good-character, language, or oath-of-allegiance sub-requirement was confirmed (plausible given every other Commonwealth Caribbean naturalisation route built this session has one, but not found on any accessible source here) -- flagged as a likely gap in sourcing rather than an actual absence of such conditions. dual_citizenship_allowed left null, not confirmed either way.
